english: My family lives in Aarhus.

# danish: Jeg har en bror og to søstre.
english: I have one brother and two sisters.
My older sister is called Sofie.
How old is your son?
He is five years old.

# danish: Mine forældre kommer på besøg i morgen.
english: My parents are coming to visit tomorrow.

# danish: Min mormor bor tæt på os.
english: My maternal grandmother lives close to us.

# danish: Vi besøger vores bedsteforældre på søndag.
english: We are visiting our grandparents on Sunday.
Are you married?

# danish: Nej, men jeg har en kæreste.
english: No, but I have a partner.
They are getting married this summer.

# danish: Min kusine har fået en datter.
english: My female cousin has had a daughter.
The children are playing together.
I miss my family.
My neighbour is very helpful.

# danish: Hun er genert, men hun er også sjov.
english: She is shy, but she is also funny.

# danish: Vil du med til min fødselsdag?
english: Would you like to come to my birthday party?
We have invited the whole family.
Thank you for looking after the children.

# danish: Jeg er glad for at se dig.
english: I am happy to see you.
